# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 73 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 73

Jesus said: "The harvest is great but the laborers are few. Beseech the Lord that he will send laborers into the harvest."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Direct parallel to Matthew 9:37-38 / Luke 10:2 (Q saying)
- **ⲡⲱϩ** / *pōh*: "harvest" — agricultural and eschatological
- "Beseech the Lord" — Thomas uses *kurios* (Lord) without qualification; in Q, "Lord of the harvest"
- Thomas omits "of the harvest" after "Lord" — making the petition more broadly theological
- One of the most exact Thomas/Q parallels
